summary: For developers: a record of Lua errors, blocked actions and recent events, to read after /reload.
description: Forever Trace keeps a record of what went wrong while you played: each Lua error with its stack and a count, each action that the game blocked, the warnings of the game, and the logins, zone changes and fights around them. It can take a screenshot when a new error happens. The game writes the record to the SavedVariables folder at /reload and at logout. Type /ftrace for commands.
